population.span: consecutive adult patients admitted for elective cardiac surgeries randomly received a 1-mg dose of colchicine (n = 81) or placebo (n = 71) orally 12 to 24 hours before surgery followed by a daily dose of 0.5 mg until hospital discharge.

endpoint.span: The primary efficacy endpoint was the development of at least one episode of AF (lasting 5 minutes or longer) occurring after cardiac surgery at any point during hospitalization.

estimate.span: The rate of AF was 16.0% (n = 13) in the colchicine group, versus 18.3% (n = 13) in the placebo group. Comparing the colchicine and placebo groups, the odds ratio was 0.85 (95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.37–1.99).

ci.span: Comparing the colchicine and placebo groups, the odds ratio was 0.85 (95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.37–1.99).

analysis_set.span: Among the 152 randomized patients, AF occurred in 26 patients (17%), including 16% of patients in the colchicine group and 18.3% of patients in the placebo group.

treatment_strategy.span: Upon enrollment, patients were treated with 1 mg of colchicine or matching placebo 12 to 24 hours prior to surgery, followed by colchicine (0.5 mg) or placebo immediately after their surgery (via a nasogastric tube) and daily treatment at this dose until hospital discharge.

follow_up.span: The primary efficacy endpoint was the development of at least one episode of AF (lasting 5 minutes or longer) occurring after cardiac surgery at any point during hospitalization.

absent_reason: No fields absent. A formal intention-to-treat label is not stated; the analysis_set span identifies the randomized cohort directly.
served_mismatch: The served arm-level counts match the source. However, the reported 0.85 (95% CI 0.37–1.99) is an OR, not the requested RR; it cannot be used as an RR estimate or RR confidence interval. The served intention-to-treat label is not explicitly stated, although results are reported for the 152 randomized patients.

candidate_rejections.span: Comparing the colchicine and placebo groups, the odds ratio was 0.85 (95% confidence interval [CI] = 0.37–1.99).
candidate_rejections.why: Rejected as an RR candidate; retained as the explicitly reported OR for the correct endpoint.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Adults undergoing elective cardiac surgery fall within the question's adult cardiac-surgery population; formal ITT terminology is not stated.

notes: All spans use the held full text. BOUND applies to the reported OR and its CI; no RR or RR CI was inferred. The abstract reports 16.1% for colchicine while the main results report 16.0%; both report 13 events.
